title: Armstrong learns to read on the Marable boat
summary: Fate Marable taught Armstrong to read.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: That's how I knew Louis could read. You know, he's talking about reading. When Louis was on the boat with Faith Marvel. And Louis was on the boat for about three or four years. Faith Marvel and then taught Louis to read. I was amazed when Louis came off that boat. He came around and taught him, and he was playing with us. We got in that Red Book, man. And didn't miss a note. That's a tough book. Yeah, man.
And you knew him before? Faith was the one who taught him?
Faith taught him. Faith taught him. And you knew him before, though? Oh, I knew him. And he went back to June when he was a kid.
And he was not a good player.
